test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The craftsman engraved a **__cartouche__ **around the ruler’s name.

options.text: The archaeologist identified the royal **cartouche** on the temple wall.
Each soldier was issued a paper **cartouche** to load into his musket.
The museum displayed a gold **cartouche** found in the queen's tomb.
An ornate stone **cartouche** was carved above the palace entrance.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2** i.e. **Each soldier was issued a paper cartouche to load into his musket.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cartouche"** as used in the original sentence refers to an oval or oblong frame, typically used in Egyptian hieroglyphics to enclose a royal name or as a decorative tablet. (नक्काशीदार ढांचा या शिलालेख)

 
 
• **Example:** The artisan spent hours polishing the stone cartouche that displayed the emperor's title.
 
 
 
• The **"cartouche"** in the correct option refers to a historical military term for a paper cartridge containing a bullet and gunpowder. (कारतूस)
 
 
• **Example:** During the 18th century, soldiers had to bite the end off the paper cartouche before loading it into their rifles.
 
 
 
• Hence, while the spelling is identical, the military meaning in Option 2 is the homonym of the architectural/archaeological meaning in the prompt.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Each soldier was issued a paper cartouche to load into his musket.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: The archaeologist identified the royal cartouche on the temple wall.** (शाही शिलालेख): This uses the word in the same context as the prompt (archaeology).

 
 
• **Example:** The royal cartouche confirmed that the temple was built during the reign of Ramses II.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: The museum displayed a gold cartouche found in the queen's tomb.** (नक्काशीदार आभूषण/नामपट्टी): This also refers to the archaeological nameplate or frame.
 
 
• **Example:** Visitors marveled at the intricate gold cartouche that had remained intact for millennia.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: An ornate stone cartouche was carved above the palace entrance.** (अलंकृत फलक): This refers to the architectural decoration similar to the original craftsman's work.
 
 
• **Example:** The baroque building featured a heavy stone cartouche displaying the family crest.
 
 

3f:Tf39,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
